MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:PLACED_IN]->(st:Store)
WHERE so.status = 'completed' AND st.country = 'CA'
  AND so.order_date >= date('2023-01-01') AND so.order_date <= date('2023-12-31')
MATCH (so)-[hl:HAS_LINE]->(l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
WITH sku, hl.qty AS lineQty
// expand bundles: bundle SKU -> item SKU x qty; non-bundle maps directly
OPTIONAL MATCH (sku)-[b:BUNDLES]->(item:SKU)
WITH sku, lineQty, collect({item: item, qty: b.qty}) AS bundleItems
WITH sku, lineQty, bundleItems,
     CASE WHEN sku.is_bundle THEN bundleItems ELSE [{item: sku, qty: 1.0}] END AS items
UNWIND items AS it
WITH it.item AS itemSku, lineQty * it.qty AS units
MATCH (itemSku)-[m:MAPS_TO]->(model:Model)
WITH model, sum(units * m.qty) AS totalUnits
RETURN model.model_code AS model_code
ORDER BY totalUnits DESC
LIMIT 3
